newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TARGET DRILL RESULTS ENCOURAGING - AVGOLD.
newsitem.headline: TARGET DRILL RESULTS ENCOURAGING - AVGOLD.

text.p: Avgold Ltd said on Tuesday that preliminary drill results from its Target division were encouraging and results on the Dreyerskuil reefs indicated upside potential on previously estimated tonnage.
However, the company said diamond drilling had fallen behind schedule. Action was being taken to rectify this.

To date exploration drilling totalling 13,195 metres has been completed and a total of 3,984 metres of reef has been sampled. Most of the sampling has occured on the Dreyerskuil and Elsburg reefs in the Eldorado Formation.
